This can be using a frequency of monthly, or a frequency of yearly with 'end of period' as the aggregation method. For example, for 2022, this value was 33.45.

rules_primary: If, for any sequence of 3 or more consecutive calendar months from January 2026 through December 2026, the U.S. Producer Price Index for Final Demand 12-month percent change is greater than the U.S. Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U), U.S. city average, all items, 12-month percent change in each month of that sequence, then the market resolves to Yes.

A qualifying streak must consist entirely of calendar months in 2026.
title: PPI YoY exceed CPI YoY for 3+ consecutive months in 2026?
